description: A dimly lit stone gatehouse with crenellated battlements and a tall corner tower, seen at night. A lantern hangs beside a dark arched passage, and a small barred window sits high on the wall. A small arched wooden door is set low on the left. Two figures in dark clothing, possibly guards, stand near the entrance on a wet cobbled street. The painting is an edge-to-edge dark oil style with no visible text or frame.
